title: Wire embedding generation into graph entity lifecycle
action: When Character/Location/Plot entities are created or updated via graph-manager, generate embedding vector using VectorSearch embedding service and store via VectorSearch.upsertEmbedding or equivalent. Add entity ID + workspaceId mapping so embeddings can be queried by entity.

criteria: Entity created in graph should produce corresponding embedding record in VectorSearch DB

implementation: 1) Import or inject VectorSearch instance into GraphManager constructor. 2) After successful entity MERGE/CREATE in graph-manager, call embedding service to generate vector from entity name + description + properties. 3) Store embedding via VectorSearch with entity ID as document ID. 4) On entity update, regenerate and upsert embedding. 5) On entity delete, remove embedding. Use existing EmbeddingService from VectorSearch.
